    AI Overview
    +2
    Master (2021) is a Tamil-language action-thriller directed by Lokesh Kanagaraj, featuring Joseph Vijay and Vijay Sethupathi. The plot follows an alcoholic professor who clashes with a gangster exploiting school children. With a high-octane storyline, the film grossed ₹220–300 crore worldwide, featured a ~3-hour runtime, and won two awards. 
    Key Details for Master (2021): 
    • Plot: John "JD" Durairaj (Vijay), a college professor with alcoholism, takes a teaching job at a juvenile detention center, where he discovers gangster Bhavani (Sethupathi) uses the children for criminal acts, leading to a showdown.
    • Cast: Joseph Vijay (JD), Vijay Sethupathi (Bhavani), Malavika Mohanan, Arjun Das, Andrea Jeremiah
      .
    • Runtime: Approximately 178-180 minutes (nearly 3 hours).
    • Budget & Earnings: Grossed around ₹220–300 crore ($27–$37 million).
    • Awards: Won 2 awards (from around 10 nominations). 
    The 2021 film was lauded for boosting the theatrical market following pandemic lockdowns and was released in Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, and Kannada languages. 
    Note: There is also a 2022 horror/thriller film titled "Master" (directed by Mariama Diallo) starring Regina Hall.
